Subject: Onboarding & MSA redlines for MedSupply — next steps

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re excited to get Redwood live for our clinical annotation tooling. Attached is our latest set of redlines to the MSA and the draft order form (MedSupply_Redlines_v3.pdf). High-level items we want to confirm up front:

- Payment terms: propose Net 45 instead of your standard Net 30 (we can compromise).
- Data residency & audit logs: we need a commitment around 3-year retention and support for SOC2 evidence during audits.
- PO numbering: our ERP uses PO prefix "MS-" and sends 12-digit numbers — we need to confirm Redwood’s Ariba mapping for PO id field.
- EDI/ACKs: can Redwood accept EDI 850/855 and provide 997 acknowledgements?

Can you loop in the right folks for legal and vendor registration so we can get the portal setup and sign once the redlines are resolved? We’re aiming for a mid-August go-live.

Attachments: MedSupply_Redlines_v3.pdf (redlined MSA + order form)

Thanks,

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onboarding & MSA redlines for MedSupply — next steps

Thanks for the ping, Logan. I reviewed the PDF quickly and have the following open items (high-level):

1) Data retention & audit scope — MedSupply asks for 3-year retention and SOC2 evidence. We can commit to 3-year telemetry retention for logging/audit trails, but we need to narrow the scope of "evidence" to standard SOC2 reports and derivative logs; any production access for third-party auditors will require an NDA and controlled process.

2) Payment terms — Net 45 is okay for enterprise customers with procurement constraints, but we should preserve the right to invoice earlier for usage overages. I'll propose: Net 45 with interest at 1.5% monthly after 60 days.

3) Liability cap & indemnity — MedSupply redlines attempt to remove the liability cap for data incidents. That is a non-starter. I recommend we keep the existing limitation but add a carve-out for gross negligence and willful misconduct.

4) Order form SLA language — need to ensure SLAs are tied to the order form (not the MSA) and include a clear credit remedy.

I've attached a short comment set (RDW_redline_comments_kpark.docx) with inline suggestions. I can draft a counter-redline (tracked) if you want me to send it to Anna directly or route through you.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Appreciate the context. Operational checklist and asks below — copying Anna so she can reply inline with the vendor-supplied info:

Operational items we need to complete Ariba/Coupa registration and order flow mapping:

1) Vendor profile data (required): Legal name, DBA (if any), Tax ID (TIN) + W-9 for US vendors, Remit-to address, Primary invoice email, Portal admin contact (name & email).
2) PO ingestion: We can accept PO numbers with prefix. Please confirm MedSupply’s prefix is exactly "MS-" and that POs will be numeric after the prefix (e.g., MS-000012345678). We'll map to our ERPid -> order_id field.
3) EDI & acknowledgements: We support EDI 850 ingestion and can produce 855 acknowledgements; for 997s we can surface the 997-style receipt via our integration team but it requires SFTP or AS2 endpoint. If MedSupply can provide an endpoint, we can enable by go-live; otherwise fall back to email-based ACKs.
4) Order form fields: Need to confirm if the order form will include per-project SLA metrics (latency p50/p95, throughput) or just monthly committed tokens. If SLA metrics are required, legal asks we include credit schedules in the order form.
5) Onboarding timeline: vendor registration (2 business days after docs), Ariba enrollment & testing (3–7 business days), EDI endpoint test (2–5 business days).

Please attach the W-9 and indicate the name and email of your portal admin. Also, if you require Net 45, we will work with Finance on invoicing cadence; provide your AP contact for billing setup.

Attachments requested: W-9, remit address, EDI connectivity details.

Thanks — I’ll draft a short vendor activation checklist and share a Drive link once we have the docs.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Vendor Activation Lead | Redwood Inference

- Vendor profile: Legal name: MedSupply Therapeutics, Inc.; DBA: MedSupply; TIN: 12-3456789 (W-9 attached); Remit: 123 BioPark Dr, Suite 400, San Mateo, CA 94403; AP contact: ap@medsupply.com (Emily Cheng).
- PO prefix: Confirmed — prefix is exactly "MS-" and POs will be formatted MS-########### (12 digits after prefix).
